components.gap: Subjective probability and conditioning are mapped to exact finite-bet/update units (def:p15-finite-conditioning, thm:p15-finite-conditioning-laws, thm:p17-finite-price-coherence, thm:p17-finite-bet-representation, thm:p17-finite-vnm, the Bayes kernel theorems, sec:p15-imprecise-probability). The source's alternatives are not mapped. The information-loss/self-location models (body 531-537) and the alternative representations Dempster-Shafer, ranking functions, belief revision and possibility theory (body 664-669) are only named as 'separate' or an 'open comparison boundary'. They carry no reference to the existing handbook units for them (e.g. sec:p15-w02b-p15-025-ranking, sec:p15-r43-rankings, handbook/parts/p08/ranked-models-and-rational-closure.tex, sec:p15-w02b-p15-034-partition-updates), so the remaining belief-change comparisons are not mapped to any unit.

On p. 247 the source states its Kullback-Leibler repair of <0.3,0.4> as C*(p)=0.438, C*(~p)=0.572, a pair that sums to 1.010. thm:p15-rat41-graded (body 572-576; annex 205-213) gives (3/7,4/7) instead. It neither reports the source's figures nor notes that they are not a coherent pair, so the source's actual example is silently replaced rather than presented with its discrepancy. The Table 4.1.1 rendering (body 612-637) also drops the source's trailing '...' row and column and its statement that the table will grow. It glosses an empty cell as 'an unexplored route rather than impossibility', whereas the source (p. 247) gives impossibility and historical contingency as the two alternatives. The other examples (die, chicken, election book, Brier vs absolute, lottery 1/100, noon coin, car rattle, cube factory, neighbour lights, tablecloth, Vladivostok, lunch bill) are present, and the claim types are distinguished.

Comparisons with the finite probability, Bayes updating, P17 betting/representation, imprecise-probability and P19 evidence units are present, with differences preserved. This packet allocates the unit to section 166.3 (continuous entropy, coordinates and reference measures). Yet the source's continuous-entropy generalization and the cube-factory representation dependence (body 335-349) are compared only with thm:p15-bayes-transformation. They are not compared with the continuous-entropy/coordinate-dependence treatment (handbook/parts/p15/information-and-description-based-inference-w02b-p15-042.tex, sec:p15-w02b-p15-042-coordinates), and neither file references the other.

Each promised proof or evidence claim is given a status in the text. Finite proofs are written in the annex items brier, positive-atoms, indifference, jeffrey, minimal-update and graded. The Dutch book theorem and its converse go through thm:p17-finite-price-coherence. Savage/Bolker, the Lewis/Skyrms diachronic Dutch books, Easwaran, Pettigrew, Armendt, the De Bona-Staffel log-score result and Slovic-Lichtenstein are marked as surveyed and unproved. However, no finite dependent-source set is fixed. The only citation is HajekStaffel2021Dynamics (the intake bib has one entry). The dependent primary sources are named in prose without being identified, and body 161-162 says the primary axiomatizations 'remain separately identified presentations' without identifying them.
